sources.prompt: Edit target: the attached Zoonii.zip wordmark. Extract its TEN individual letters into ONE transparent sprite atlas. Preserve original vintage worn fruit-produce label stickers, blue sunrise Z, orange o, cream organic o, red n, yellow i with lemon dot, blue i with blue star dot, small orange fruit period, green leaf z, orange i with orange leaf dot, yellow palm p. Reconstruct only the tiny hidden overlap edges to make complete isolated objects. EXACT layout: a regular 5 column by 2 row grid on a wide 5:2 canvas, all ten equal cells. Top row left to right: Z, o, o, n, i. Bottom row: i, period dot, z, i, p. Each complete object centered in its own cell with generous transparent padding and no crossing cell boundaries. Keep dots of each i paired with its stem in the SAME cell. Letters must remain individually readable and match source textures/colors/artwork. No neighboring letter fragments, no extra characters, no labels, no grid, no background, no checkerboard, genuine transparent alpha. This is a website sprite sheet of isolated source assets, not a new composed wordmark. Every cell equal width and equal height. Please use a wide 2500 by 1000 composition.
